rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF RICHARD LOUIS LEDON
rulings.Calendar Matter: ACCOUNTING PETITION RE: Accounting #1, Report, Fees, Final Distribution
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 10/6/26. (No earlier availability.) Issue(s) necessitating continuance: (1) The amended petition was filed on 7/16/26. Notice is defective if mailed before the filing of the pleading requiring notice. [LRSF 14.14 A.] "Filing" means when the pleading requiring notice appears on the Court's register of actions and becomes publicly viewable. (2) Do the uncles and aunts represent both the maternal and paternal sides? (3) A 13100 affidavit must have the mandatory Judicial Council form DE-300 attached to it. (4) David Lee Kotta's death certificate shows that he was also survived by a spouse, Catherine Kotta... (5) Receipts may not include transfers from estate accounts or proceeds from the sale of assets in the estate, etc. [Probate Code Section 1061(a)(2).] (6) Gains and losses should show the date of each sale, the date of death value of each asset, the sale price, and the gain or loss. (7) Transfer of cash between accounts is not a change in the FORM of assets. [Prob. C. Sect. 1063(b).] (8) All of the cash, in excess of the FDIC insured amount, is held at one bank. [Probate Code Section 9700.] (9) It appears that there were 15 first cousins, which is the level at which the estate should divide. [Probate Code Section 240.] Please provide a courtesy copy of any papers filed to address these issues to the assigned examiner by 8/7/26. (It is not necessary to attach to a petition copies of papers previously filed.) Examiner continuances are final and not subject to contest under LRSF 14.10 B. NB: In order for this Court to track closed matters, orders to terminate and distribute an estate must begin with the following language: "Order for Final Distribution." [LRSF 14.35 I.6.b.]

rulings.Case Title: IN THE MATTER OF THE THE NANCY COX MARITAL TRUST, THE FREDCOX CREDIT TRUST
rulings.Calendar Matter: Petition For Order Ascertaining Beneficiaries And Determining To Whom Property Shall Pass Upon Final Termination Of The Trust.
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 09/29/2026. Issues necessitating continuance: 1) The proper county for commencement of a proceeding is, in the case of a living trust, the county where the principal place of administration of the trust is located (Probate Code Section 17005(a)(1)). The trustee's mailing address is listed as being in St. Louis, MO. Please clarify how venue in San Francisco is appropriate. 2) The instant petition suggests that the decedent died before she was able to "update" the reference from the Cox Foundation to the Cox Foundation DAF and prior to formal dissolution of the Cox Foundation with the Secretary of State, although four years passed from its inception and the decedent's date of the death. Additionally, the Secretary of State website does not reflect that the Cox Foundation has been dissolved, and neither the principal address nor the mailing address are consistent with the address listed in the instant petition. Please clarify the status of the Cox Foundation and explain why notice was given to an address in San Francisco that no longer appears to be affiliated with the Cox Foundation. 3) No proposed order has been received or lodged with the court (LRSF 14.7.A). Please address the above issues and deliver courtesy copies of all further filings to this examiner no later than 09/15/2026 to avoid additional continuance.

rulings.Case Title: IN THE MATTER OF THE MEI MEI YANG LIVING TRUST DATED AUGUST 6 2014 as amended October 26 2020 HONG FU YANG Acting Tru
rulings.Calendar Matter: Verified Petition For Order Determining Claim To Real Property And Confirming As Trust Owner Prob Code 850 851 856 857 15200 15206 Evid
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 10/6/26. (No earlier availability.) Issue(s) necessitating continuance: (1) Notice must have attached to it the procedures for how to make a remote appearance by Zoom and CourtCall, as well as remote public access, as set out at https://sf.courts.ca.gov/divisions/probate-court. [LRSF 14.1 C.6.] (2) All petitions involving a trust must state the names and last known addresses of all vested or contingent beneficiaries. [CRC 7.902.] Unless an exception applies, such beneficiaries must either receive or waive notice. (3) Prob. C. Sect. 850 is a shortcut for a formal probate proceeding. A beneficiary of the trust receives mailed notice with a copy of the petition, but any heir-at-law, who would stand to inherit, if the trust did not exist or were invalid, is a party whose right, title or interest would be affected by this petition, and, therefore, must receive (or waive) personal service of notice. [Prob. C. Sect. 17203(b) and CCP Sect. 413.10 et seq.] (4) Venue is determined by where the trust is administered. Does the successor trustee also resied in Burlingame? Then, the proper venue for this petition is San Mateo County. (5) A courtesy copy of the petition was not provided, so it was only cursorily reviewed online. If the property is deemed to be an asset of the trust, Probate Code Sections 856-857 should not be necessary; the successor trustee merely needs to record order granting the petition. If the petition is not withdrawn in order to be filed in the correct venue, please provide courtesy copies of the petition and any papers filed to address these issues to the assigned examiner by 9/28/26. Examiner continuances are final and not subject to contest under LRSF 14.10 B. NB: Courtesy copies are FILE STAMPED, single-sided, hard copies. [LRSF 14.7 B. and C.]

If so, compliance with Probate Code section 13655(a)(2) must be shown by: (i) alleging the name and address of each person interested in the trust, as determined in cases of future interests pursuant to section 15804; and (ii) giving notice to each person interested in the trust. 6) The decedent's interest in each real property did not pass to petitioner individually as the surviving spouse, as the decedent left a pour-over will. See section 13501(b). Is petitioner requesting an order only confirming a 25% interest in each real property as belonging to petitioner without administration? 7) Is the correct APN for 1636-1638 Great Hwy 1895-053 (instead of 1895-503 as alleged)?

rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF BARRY M. PAPER
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 9/16/26 for the following issues: (1) Duties and Liabilities of Personal Representative (DE-147) must be on file. (2) Confidential Statement (DE-147S) must be filed. See LR 14.48.E. (3) Notice of Direction for Remote Appearances and Access (LR 14.1.C.6). (4) The Court will likely require a full bond of $360,000 as this petition does not ascertain the characterization of the property and the entitlement of the (then) surviving spouse. (5) Petition #8 lists Richard A. Peterson as the "successor trustee," not the personal representative. Petition #8 does not explain whether there has been or will be any probate proceeding of the post-deceased spouse. If commenced, the petition must identify the name, and a copy of the Letters must be filed. If there is no need to open a probate, a proper showing/explanation must be on file. Please see LR 14.18.D. (6) Petition #8 must indicate the date of death of all deceased heirs, including the decedent's parents and their issues other than the petitioner, if any. Local Rule 14.18.D. (7) Petition #3.h.(3) must include the proposed administrator's address. (8) Proposed order must be submitted. See LR 14.7.A.1. Please ensure that any material required in the petition is verified by the petitioner. All issues must be resolved at least two weeks before the hearing.
